- class: CommandLineTool
  id: 2stac2_mpa_pipeline
  baseCommand: python
  arguments:
  - /opt/2stac2.py
  inputs:
    simulation:
      format: edam:format_3650
      doc: simulation NetCDF file
      type: File
      inputBinding:
        prefix: --file
    connectivity:
      format: edam:format_3620
      doc: connectivity file
      type: File?
      inputBinding:
        prefix: --file
    connectivity_with_locality_id:
      format: edam:format_3620
      doc: connectivity with locality id
      type: File?
      inputBinding:
        prefix: --file
    metadata:
      format: edam:format_3464
      doc: metadata file description
      type: File
      loadContents: true
      inputBinding:
        prefix: --metadata
        valueFrom: $(runtime.outdir + '/multiple_metadata.json')
  outputs:
    stac_result:
      outputBinding:
        glob: stac_result
      type: Directory
      doc: STAC output
  requirements:
    EnvVarRequirement:
      envDef:
        PATH: /opt/conda/envs/application/bin:/opt/conda/condabin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
    ResourceRequirement: {}
    InlineJavascriptRequirement: {}
    DockerRequirement:
      dockerPull: iliad-repository.inesctec.pt/2stac2:0.3.2
    InplaceUpdateRequirement:
      inplaceUpdate: true
    InitialWorkDirRequirement:
      listing: "${\n  const content = JSON.parse(inputs.metadata.contents);\n  const\
        \ metadata = [];\n  metadata.push({...content, filename:inputs[\"simulation\"\
        ].basename});\n  if(inputs[\"connectivity\"] && inputs[\"connectivity\"].basename)\n\
        \    metadata.push({...content, filename:inputs[\"connectivity\"].basename\
        \ , media_type:\"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet\"\
        });\n  if(inputs[\"connectivity_with_locality_id\"] && inputs[\"connectivity_with_locality_id\"\
        ].basename)\n    metadata.push({...content, filename:inputs[\"connectivity_with_locality_id\"\
        ].basename , media_type:\"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet\"\
        });\n  return [{\"class\": \"File\", \"basename\": \"multiple_metadata.json\"\
        , \"contents\": JSON.stringify(metadata) }];\n}\n"
  s:name: 2stac2_mpa_pipeline
